$comment: State-layer config (ADR-0007). backend: none | github-projects | gitlab | jira | notion | linear (implemented, native semantics) | trello (stub). forge: where PRs/MRs live — feedback is ALWAYS pulled from the forge, independent of backend. Set by /core:new-project; the board outlives /orchestrator:enable-orchestrator and /orchestrator:disable-orchestrator. Per-backend keys: jira {projectKey, epicIssueType?, childIssueType?, statusMap?} · notion {dataSourceId, initiativesDataSourceId?, databaseId? (legacy)} · linear {teamKey, stateMap?, createMissingLabels?}. A non-none backend pushes state from inside the sandbox — allowlist its host (orchestrator/egress-allowlist.txt) or every push fails closed mid-run.
